units: <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 169:3">Sifré Deut. 169</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 18:8">Deut. XVIII, 8</cite>) <he>מה מָכְרוּ וכ׳</he> what have the fathers sold to one another? (Answ. the weekly turns); <cite ref="Sukkah 56a:2">Succ. 56ᵃ</cite>; Y. ib. V, end, 55ᵈ.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 64b">B. Bath. 64ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>מוֹכֵר בעין יפה מוכר</he> the seller is presumed to sell liberally, i.e. to sell all except that which is specified as excluded; <he>מ׳ בעיין רעה מ׳</he> he sells only that which is specified as sold. Ib. IV, 1 …<he>המוכר … לא מ׳ וכ׳</he> if one sells …, he has not implicitly sold &c.
Sot. III, 8 אין האשה מוֹכֶרֶת וכ׳ a woman cannot sell her daughter; a. v. fr.—Part. pass. מָכוּר; f. מְכוּרָה; pl. מְכוּרִים מְכוּרִין; מְכוּרוֹת.
<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 3:4">Tosef. Ab. Zar. III</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 4:18">IV</cite>), 18 <he>הרי זה מ׳</he> he is sold (the sale is valid).
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 7:8">Tosef. B. Kam. VII, 8</cite> <he>חביות המ׳ וכ׳</he> wine casks which have been sold to the shopkeeper (awaiting delivery); a. v. fr.

senses.gloss: to be sold. Sot. l. c. האיש נ׳ … נִמְכֶּרֶת a man can be sold for his theft, but a woman cannot &c. Mekh. Mishp. s. 2; a. fr.
